name: docent
description: Explain a change with a short narrated walkthrough video: real browser and terminal recordings of the running software, local voice narration, captions and chapters.

interface.shortDescription: Explain a change with a narrated video
interface.longDescription: Turn a branch, pull request or release into a short narrated walkthrough that shows what changed and why. Docent reads the change, runs the real software locally, records browser and terminal scenes with a visible pointer, narrates with a local voice, and assembles a captioned 1080p MP4 with chapters. It can also give a narrated tour of a whole repository.
defaultPrompt: Make a walkthrough of this branch.
Explain this pull request in a short narrated video.
Give me a narrated tour of this repo.
